doc.name: YerevanEstate — Yerevan apartment market
doc.instructions: Data on Yerevan apartment prices from sale and rent listings and government deal counts. Call get_market_overview first for context. Always cite month, n and that prices are asking prices. Read the methodology resource before interpreting numbers. All statistics are free. Tools marked [Premium] return individual listings and need a Premium key (this connection is FREE: those tools return only a count and a link to https://www.yerevanestate.am/ai#premium).

tools.name: get_market_overview
tools.title: Yerevan market overview
tools.description: Average asking price per m² (USD) for Yerevan and each of its 12 districts, change since Sep 2025, number of listings, and deals per district in the last full year. Цены на квартиры в Ереване по районам.

tools.name: get_district
tools.title: District details
tools.description: One Yerevan district: price per m² by month, and prices split by new build vs secondary, renovation and building material. Подробно о районе.

district.description: District: name in English, Russian or Armenian (e.g. Arabkir, Арабкир, Արաբկիր) or number 2–13

tools.name: estimate_price
tools.title: Estimate an apartment price or rent
tools.description: Fair price range for a Yerevan apartment from comparable listings: median, 25th–75th percentile and, if a price is given, a verdict (below / in / above market) plus up to 5 similar listings. Sale: total for the given m². Rent: per month. Оценка квартиры: дорого или нет.

district.description: District: name in English, Russian or Armenian (e.g. Arabkir, Арабкир, Արաբկիր) or number 2–13

newConstruction.description: Yes = new build, No = secondary market

price.description: Asking price to judge, USD (sale total or monthly rent)

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.title: Monthly price history for a segment
tools.description: Monthly average asking price per m² (USD and AMD) and listing counts for one segment: district × material × new/secondary × renovation. Use district 'Yerevan' or 1 for the whole city.

district.description: District name/number, or 'Yerevan' / 1 for the city

newConstruction.description: Yes = new build, No = secondary market

tools.name: get_rental_yields
tools.title: Rental yield by district
tools.description: Gross rental yield per district for one apartment type: median yield %, typical range, median monthly rent, median purchase price, payback years, sample size. Где выгоднее сдавать квартиру.

newConstruction.description: Yes = new build, No = secondary market

tools.name: get_deals
tools.title: Apartment deals (government data)
tools.description: Number of apartment sale deals per month from government data, split into new-build (from developer) and secondary. Optionally for one district. Сколько квартир продано.

district.description: District: name in English, Russian or Armenian (e.g. Arabkir, Арабкир, Արաբկիր) or number 2–13

tools.name: search_listings
tools.title: Search current listings
tools.description: [Premium] Find apartments currently listed for sale or rent (seen in the last 14 days) by district, street or block, distance from a point, rooms, price, area, new build and renovation. Returns up to 20 with price, $/m², street and an id for get_listing. Найти квартиры в продаже или аренде.

district.description: District: name in English, Russian or Armenian (e.g. Arabkir, Арабкир, Արաբկիր) or number 2–13

street.description: Street or block name in Armenian, English or Russian, old names and typos are fine (e.g. Komitas, Կոմիտաս, Комитаса, Davtashen 1st Block)

near.description: Only listings within radiusM metres of this point

tools.name: get_price_drops
tools.title: Listings whose price just dropped
tools.description: [Premium] Live listings whose asking price went down: current price vs the highest price in the last `days` days (default 30), biggest drops first. Filter by district, street, rooms. Квартиры, которые подешевели.

district.description: District: name in English, Russian or Armenian (e.g. Arabkir, Арабкир, Արաբկիր) or number 2–13

street.description: Street or block name in any language

tools.name: get_street
tools.title: One street or block
tools.description: Prices on one Yerevan street or block (quarter): median $/m² with p25–p75, new build vs resale, active listings, days on market, share of price cuts — for sale and rent, plus ~600 m segments of long streets (Komitas, Tigran Mets…) and the 5 buildings with most listings. Accepts names in Armenian, English, Russian, old names and typos. Every answer has n, window and fallback (radius500/district when the street has < 15 listings). Цены по улице.

name.description: e.g. Komitas, Կոմիտասի պողոտա, проспект Комитаса, Baghramyan, Davtashen 1st Block

tools.name: estimate_address
tools.title: Price at an exact address + what's nearby
tools.description: Price for a flat at an exact Yerevan address (e.g. 'Komitas 42', 'Комитаса 42', 'Կոմիտաս 42'): finds the building, estimates sale price (per m² and total) and monthly rent with a model trained on all listings (location down to the street segment, floor, renovation, building, metro, parks, schools, kindergartens), shows which factors push the price up or down, the building's floors/material, the street's median price, and distances to metro, schools, kindergartens, parks, playgrounds, shops, pharmacies, hospitals. Free. Цена по точному адресу и что рядом.

floors.description: floors in the building, if known (else taken from the building data)

tools.name: get_area_stats
tools.title: Prices around a point
tools.description: Live asking-price stats for all listings within radiusM (default 500 m) of a point: median $/m², p25–p75, new vs resale, days on market, price cuts, plus the main streets in the circle. Use for 'how much near X' after geocoding X. Цены вокруг точки.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.title: One listing with price history
tools.description: [Premium] Full details for one listing by id: specs, price history, days on market, fair-price verdict and comparables.

id.description: listing id as returned by search_listings / get_price_drops (starts with L)

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search (ChatGPT connector)
tools.description: Search Yerevan prices. FREE: a street ('Komitas', 'Saryan') or an address ('Lvovyan 17') returns its price statistics; pass the returned id to `fetch`. [Premium] free-text search over current listings, e.g. '2 rooms Arabkir under 120000'.

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch (ChatGPT connector)
tools.description: Fetch the result of `search` by id: street:<id> and address:<text> are free (price stats); a listing id is [Premium].
